title: Number of Neets in UK falls below a million as Burnham pushes to tackle crisis
summary: Latest figure of young people not in education, employment or training remains close to highest level in a decade

blocks.text:
Latest figure of young people not in education, employment or training remains close to highest level in a decade

  • Business live – latest updates

  • UK politics live – latest updates

The number of young people across the UK not in education, employment or training (Neet) has decreased but remains close to a million as Andy Burnham’s government pushes to tackle Britain’s youth jobs crisis.

As ministers prepare to make sweeping changes in response to Alan Milburn’s landmark report into young people and work, the Office for National Statistics (ONS) said the number of Neets fell by 22,000 in the three months to September, to 959,000.
